reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared helpers getRangeScheduleAmount and getExpectedScheduleAmount, keeping getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No new logic is duplicated; the rule is simplified in place (Math.min and amount - threshold).

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where all server and client consumers already get it.

scope.why: Only the two rule functions, their comments and the matching tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Minimal, readable change to the single definition of the worst-case rule with updated tests.
